text: Also. did u ever do the tunnels / bridges ?
resolution: Answered the user's question directly: no — tunnels/bridges did NOT land this session. Of the four elevation modes in the agreed design (grade / deck / approach strips / tunnel hole-mask), only GRADE landed (685d7eb8d: roads smooth the terrain under their bed). Bridges (= deck mode: floor pieces over water/gaps + gentle heightfield approach strips; physics already supports walk-under stacked heightfields) and tunnels (= terrain hole-mask + deck tube) are still queued — they are in the handoff brief's item 4 standing queue and the project_road_grammar memory horizon. No code changed for this entry.
